guides.title: 埋入式電源軌整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Buried power-rail integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「電源與訊號分離」建立判讀邊界。埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate power and signals to define the interpretation boundary. Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜電源與訊號分離：檢查結果是否能支持「埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜軌接觸落點：檢查結果是否能支持「通孔需要可靠落在軌上並維持周圍隔離。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜埋軌放行：檢查結果是否能支持「電性、隔離、熱相容與可佈線性需全部有證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate power and signals: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Place rail contacts: Check whether the evidence supports: Vias must land reliably on rails while preserving surrounding isolation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release buried-rail integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Electrical, isolation, thermal compatibility and routability all need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「軌接觸落點」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「埋軌放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Place rail contacts: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release buried-rail integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「電源與訊號分離」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「軌接觸落點」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate power and signals and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for place rail contacts and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.
